verdict.rationale: Smooth documents a public REST API with an API reference covering tasks (list, cancel), sessions, events for session actions (run_task, goto, extract, evaluate_js, close), custom tools, and a polling model. An SDK quickstart shows running a task in a few lines of code. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed candidate paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API itself.
